description: Read-only Audience Export diagnostics. Lists existing audience exports, state counts, and optionally samples rows from an existing export.

includePersonalIdentifiers.description: Explicitly include user/device identifiers in the optional sample. False redacts them by default.

includeRowSample.description: If true, query a small row sample from audienceExportName. Can include user-level export dimensions.

pageSize.description: Maximum items requested per page. Follow the returned pagination information for remaining results.

sampleLimit.description: Maximum records included in the diagnostic sample.

name: ga4_get_audience_export_diagnostics

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: ga4 get audience export diagnostics
